subject: youtube.channel_operating_system.current
summary: Council adopted Channel Operating System v1 as the default end-to-end method for the broad multilingual visual-documentary channel, covering trend radar, topic scoring, evidence, packaging, scene-aware script and voice direction, reference frames, transitions, asset provenance, anti-slop QC, multilingual delivery, publishing gate and analytics learning.

details.trend_rule: No raw trend becomes an episode until reframed as a durable question.
details.script_rule: Every narration unit carries intent, emotion, energy, pace, pitch, emphasis, pauses, visual beat, evidence IDs and localization note.
details.visual_rule: Consistency comes from palette/type/grid/motion grammar; each episode must still define at least three unique visual motifs.
details.transition_rule: Transitions must be motivated by object, shape, color, direction, time, cause/effect, scale or semantic contrast.
